title: DORA Power BI Report
content:
We have one data set and one report (see below) which can be downloaded as a pbix (binary) file for editing in Power BI desktop on Windows. The reports can as well be edited online. In addition to the reports we use the Power BI desktop to publish report to IPEX.

Updating the DORA report and app

To add new data to report would imply

  • updating two files

  • publishing (Data file and Report File) to DevOps workspace

  • publishing to Templates workspace

  • update the Power BI app

  • update the Change log tab with the relevant changes applied

DORA Metrics Data V1.pbix is the report that keeps all the data that our IPEX generic report as well as all copies are dependent on. Hence the version in the name. The master copy is published to the DevOps workspace in Power BI.

DORA Metrics Report V2.pbix is the report that contains the report that we use as the IPEX generic report. The master copy is published to the DevOps workspace in Power BI and as well published to template workspace in Power BI. By saving the report in the template workspace it is possible for all IPEX team members to either copy or download file for customization.

The DORA Metrics Report is as well published as an Power BI app.

When a report is updated, the published Power BI app needs to be updated with the new changes

When you change content for the app you need to make the new content visible to be able to publish app. This is done in audience step (3) of updating the app.

Scheduled update of dataset

The update of the shared dataset used by IPEX aggregated report and custom reports is set in Power BI online. The data is set to update daily.
